name: fno_darcy_native
_comment: Original Li et al. 2020 Darcy flow (piececonst_r421_N1024_smooth1) on its native 421 x 421 solver grid, as redistributed in the Hugging Face dataset LDA1020/codepde-data (darcy/piececonst_r421_N1024_smooth1_sample100.hdf5, 100 samples). coeff: a in {3, 12} (uint8), sol: u (float64), -div(a grad u) = 1 with u = 0 on the boundary.
